about: Anand Rathi Wealth Ltd was incorporated on March 22, 1995. It is an AMFI registered mutual fund distributor and is one of the leading non-bank wealth solutions firms in India, being ranked amongst the top three non-bank mutual fund distributors in the country. The company offers a wide product portfolio of wealth solutions, financial product distribution, and technology solutions to its clients. [1]
